snippet.title: Blacksmith Master - Launch Trailer | Medieval Sim Management
snippet.description:
Manage your own medieval smithy in Blacksmith Master, out now on Steam, GOG, Epic Game Store, and Humble!

As the head of your smithy, supervise everything from mining ores and gems to designing and selling finished products. Expand your business and forge everything from weapons, armor, tools, and cooking utensils to become the ultimate Blacksmith Master!

WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2292800/Blacksmith_Master/
GOG Store: https://www.gog.com/en/game/blacksmith_master
EPIC Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/blacksmith-master-1c82f8
HUMBLE Store: https://www.humblebundle.com/store/blacksmith-master
